description: The line plot titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) over six training epochs for five different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper tiny model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 20 to 70, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 10. Five distinct lines represent different quantization and fine-tuning strategies: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (solid gray line with circle markers) starts at ~69 WER and declines steadily to ~40; “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (solid gray line with square markers) begins at ~60 and drops to ~32; “tiny int4” (dashed gray line with circle markers) starts at ~69 and falls to ~39; “tiny int8” (dashed gray line with square markers) begins at ~60 and ends at ~36; and “tiny full” (dotted gray line with triangle markers) starts at ~29, dips slightly to ~24 at epoch 3, then stabilizes around ~23 by epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend in WER over epochs, with “tiny full” consistently achieving the lowest error rate throughout training.
